title: Airy Aerated Japanese Olive Sushi
description: A romantic Japanese dish featuring pitted black olives and caramelized flavors, this vegetarian-friendly sushi is a unique twist on traditional recipes. It is a fatty and aerated dish perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and cook it according to the package instructions with 1 3/4 cups of water.
In a small saucepan, combine rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Once the rice is cooked, mix it with the vinegar mixture and let it cool to room temperature.
Caramelize the pitted black olives by heating them in a saucepan with olive oil over low heat for 10 minutes.
Cut the noru sheets into desired shapes and sizes for the sushi.
Assemble the sushi by spreading a thin layer of cooled rice onto the noru sheets, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Arrange the caramelized olives in the middle of the rice.
Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat and slice it into individual pieces.
Garnish with sesame seeds and pickled ginger.
